pages.text: The $(bold)Bong$() is the simplest way to consume weed and receive its effects. No rolling required.$(br)$(br)$(bold)How to use:$()$(br)1. Hold any $(bold)weed item$() in your $(bold)offhand$()$(br)2. Hold the $(bold)Bong$() in your main hand$(br)3. Hold $(bold)right-click$() to take a hit$(br)$(br)The weed in your offhand is consumed and you receive the strain's effects based on its $(bold)THC$() and $(bold)CBD$() values.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Also:$() Bongs can be found as loot in $(bold)Trial Chambers$() — an early alternative before crafting your own.
